Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass:
Wahahaha! Today's technology is a wondrous thing!
Take this volcanic ash here. It can be fashioned into glass.
Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh:
It's fun walking through the volcano's ashes on the ground and grass.
You can see where you walked--it's really neat!
Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItem:
TRAINER TIPS
You may register one of the KEY ITEMS in your BAG as SELECT.
Simply press SELECT to use the registered item conveniently.
Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign: GLASS WORKSHOP “Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”
